reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V1 (the agent's recommended favourite: 'Ship V1') as ks_yaw_rate = (v_mps/L)*tan(delta_road_rad) minus a per-segment bias fitted on straight-regime rows (|delta_road|<0.01), exactly per triage.v1_ks_recalibrated; L taken per-platform from code/parameters.py.
notes: V1 = KS yaw-rate (v/L * tan(delta_road)) with per-sim.csv-segment bias removal (bias = mean(pred_KS - meas) over straight-regime rows where |delta_road|<0.01). L is platform-specific (Mach-E 2.984m, F-150 Lightning 3.70m). Bias is computed using all straight rows in the segment (pre-filter), to mirror the agent's procedure; RMSE is then pooled over rows with v_mps>2.0 across all 545 Ford segments.
